name: Thela Stock Manager
changelog: v3.1.0: Transaction Date Selection & In-Place Transaction Edit Suite: (1) 1-tap Date Selection chips ([Today], [Yesterday]) and [📅 Custom Date] picker ensuring accurate backdated logging, (2) Dedicated AMOLED Cyber/Glass Edit Modal (#modal-edit-tx) accessible via ✏️ Edit buttons across both Main Screen Recent List and 50-Record Drawer, (3) Full 5-field editing (Date, Bag Item, OUT/IN Action, Quantity, Note) with automated differential stock balance math, (4) Google Apps Script webhook in-place updater (action: 'edit') with full backwards-compatible fallback.
